extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic performance data are in Figure 5. Panels 5a-d were digitised and combined by catalyst and temperature; Figure 5e repeats the same methanol selectivity versus CO2 conversion points and was used only as a cross-check. Figure 6 is an Arrhenius plot and was skipped per instructions. CO formation rates plotted in Figure 5d are stored in notes because the response schema has no dedicated CO formation-rate field; CO selectivity values are inferred as 100 - methanol selectivity because the paper states methanol and CO were the only carbon-containing products.
